summary: Iteration 108: Comprehensive testing of Series feature (CRUD, candidates, play, user listing, auth), search reindex hook, and AI chapters endpoint, plus full frontend coverage of /series/:id page, create flow, auto-next overlay (via synthetic ended event), chapters AI generation UI, viewer profile tab, and regressions. All backend tests passed (16/16, 1 skipped). All critical frontend flows passed.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking series-delete and accepting the confirm() dialog via page.on('dialog', accept), the UI remained on /series/<id> and the series was NOT deleted (verified via /api/series/mine listing — had to clean up via API). The dialog may not be captured in time due to registration ordering, or the delete handler may not navigate on success. Low-priority, cleanup still possible via API. Worth confirming the delete handler awaits the response and calls navigate(-1).

action_items: (Low) Verify series-delete UI handler accepts confirm dialog and navigates away after successful DELETE — manual click may already work, but automated confirm acceptance did not trigger deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/series.py is clean and well-structured (<300 LOC). ObjectId excluded correctly throughout. Visibility and ownership checks are correctly scoped.
generate_chapters() correctly returns 422 when the audio has no detectable speech (matches expected behavior for the seeded Jack Russell test video).
_own_long_ids filters and preserves order while dropping duplicates and non-owned/non-long ids — matches API contract (invalid ids dropped silently).
Search reindex is called from create/update and remove from delete — verified end-to-end via unique-title test (created → found; deleted → gone).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 passed, 1 skipped — no short video available for 400 test)
success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical paths OK; one minor delete-dialog quirk in automation)
